Gennaro Gattuso expressed his ‘pride’ as Lazio swept Lecce aside 3-0 to stay top of the Serie A table. ‘I don’t mind misplaced passes, because we play at such a high tempo.’
The Aquile will spend at least another week on top of the Serie A table following today’s 3-0 victory over Cagliari at the Stadio Olimpico.
Tijjani Noslin found the net twice before Davide Frattesi put the cherry on top with a delightful lob in the final minutes of the match.
Gattuso so proud of Lazio mentality
“I am proud of the mentality and the hunger shown by the team today,” Gattuso told DAZN Italia.
“We didn’t have the best start, but then got control of the game, both in possession and off the ball. Lecce are an uncomfortable opponent, they always come and push you, so it is fundamental for us to keep this attitude.”
There is always some concern for coaches after the break for international duty, but Gattuso assures he had no such qualms about his Lazio players.
“I saw the way they were training, so I was not worried. There is a great spirit and application, we’ve got to keep going like this. It is all down to the players, they are putting in the right mentality, hunger and sense of belonging. They are doing something incredible.”
Lazio are top of the table and still unbeaten in Serie A despite a lot of injury problems, as today they were missing Mattia Zaccagni, Nuno Tavares, Josip Sutalo and Adam Marusic.
Nicolò Rovella also came off the bench late on and is still trying to work his way back to full fitness after numerous issues.
“Rovella can give us more vertical passes, as when he gets the ball, he immediately looks up and forward,” explained the coach.
“I think we also need to talk about Fisayo Dele-Bashiru. He deserves more. We’ve got to give Rovella playing time so that he can regain fitness, then he can give us an important hand.”
Considering how well Lazio are doing under Gattuso so far this season, is there anything he still hasn’t seen and wants them to improve?
“I don’t mind losing the ball with misplaced passes that much, because when you play at a high tempo, that can happen. I am more interested in the mentality of the side and how they are hanging in there under pressure.
“I am satisfied, you always want something more, but at this tempo there are going to be some misplaced passes. We can improve our reading of the game, as for example today when we struggled to get through the middle, we needed to spread the game out wide.”

מאמן לאציו, ג'נארו גאטוזו, שיבח את האופי והרעב של שחקניו אחרי ניצחון מרשים של קבוצתו, שהבטיח לה לפחות עוד שבוע אחד בראש טבלת הסרייה א'. למרות היעדרותם של מספר שחקני מפתח עקב פציעות, הקבוצה הפגינה עליונות לאורך ההתמודדות הודות לשערים של טיג'אני נסלין ודוידה פראטסי.

גאטוזו הסביר כי אינו חושש מאיבודי כדור שנובעים מניסיונות לשחק בקצב משחק מהיר וגבוה, שכן הדגש המרכזי מבחינתו הוא על המנטליות והיכולת להישאר מרוכזים תחת לחץ היריבה. לדבריו, הרוח הקבוצתית ומחויבות השחקנים הם הגורמים המרכזיים שמובילים את הקבוצה להציג יכולת גבוהה ומרשימה מפתיחת העונה.

המאמן הוסיף כי שחקנים חוזרים כמו ניקולו רובלה צפויים לתרום משמעותית בהמשך הדרך עם חזרתם המלאה לכושר משחק, והדגיש את החשיבות של שיפור קריאת המשחק והפצת הכדורים לאגפים כאשר מרכז המגרש צפוף.
